clips.title: The story
paras: Along Ashenvale's northwestern shore, Talen seeks the Ancient Statuette he recovered from Zoram's sunken ruins. The night elf effigy came from a city lost beneath the waves.

The sunken ruins of Zoram lie off northwestern Ashenvale. The pre-Sundering night elven city was lost beneath the waves ten thousand years ago. Recently, the explorer Talen surveyed the ruins from a small craft, searching for historical relics. Naga attacked and drove him ashore. In his flight, he left most of his belongings behind, including the ancient statuette he had dredged up. It lies on the tideline sand near his scuttled skiff.

Talen calls the statuette his most prized possession and the reason he braved the monster-infested coast. He believes the effigy can help decipher Zoram's architecture, history, and arcane secrets, all hidden beneath the surf of Zoram Strand.
